choice_rule: Among the test-set files whose name says psremoting or wsman (PowerShell remoting) and whose wsmprovhost.exe start was linked to a cross-machine fact by a guess (test.json pooled.wsman_files), the one with the most facts; a tie goes to the first name in alphabetical order.
story: IT001's powershell.exe connected 3 times to HR001 on port 5985, and HR001 recorded the same connections, so each one is a fact (recorded on both machines).

1.1 seconds after HR001 recorded the first of these connections, HR001 started wsmprovhost.exe (the Windows program that runs PowerShell commands sent from another machine). That the connection caused it is only a guess, graded low: HR001 might start it on its own.
The guess cites the latest connection in its time window, which HR001 recorded 0.8 seconds after the start (the window allows a cause recorded up to 2 seconds late).
The other 30 facts are connections between system programs (System, lsass.exe, svchost.exe); the picture shows them, but they are not part of this step.
kept: every cross-machine edge of the file (facts and guesses), the processes / endpoints they touch, and the process starts one hop from each guessed remote start (its parent and children, same machine)
